about.bio: I'm a Computer Systems Engineer with 6+ years of experience building and shipping web and mobile applications for banking, fintech, manufacturing and automotive clients. I specialize in the React and Node.js ecosystem, with solid backend foundations in Java/Spring Boot and SQL/NoSQL databases. I enjoy the entire process — from analysis to deployment — with a focus on performance, accessibility and maintainability. I'm currently pursuing an AI Expert Engineer specialization (2025–2026).
